checksum.empty_input: protocol refusal; matches the nonempty walChecksumBytes precondition
checksum.arithmetic: Each of the two rolling sums wraps modulo 2^32 after its update.

header.input_fields: Eight big-endian u32 words, regardless of checksum order.
header.page_size: Power of two from 512 through 65536; the value 1 is not a WAL page size.
header.checksum_region: First 24 bytes; seed zero; order from low bit of magic.

admission_order: transport and externally bound page size
checksum_regions_in_order: First 8 bytes of the frame header
frame.checksum_excluded_region: Header bytes 8 through 23, including salts and stored checksum.
frame.page_number_domain: 1 through 2^32-1 as in walDecodeFrame; wider pager/database limits are external.
frame.commit_marker: Nonzero commit_database_page_count is returned without granting commit, recovery or visibility authority.

refusals.4294967292: invalid WAL magic/page size or zero frame page number

success_return: Exact fixed output size in bytes: 8, 32 or 16.
foreign_allocation_preconditions: All declared spans are valid initialized allocations for the entire call.
The output is exclusive and does not alias input or immutable control.
The caller excludes concurrent mutation and binds frame seed, salts and page size to the same validated WAL chain.
scope_difference_from_internal_C: Internal walDecodeFrame mutates Wal.hdr.aFrameCksum on checksum failure. This isolated byte API keeps command/output unchanged on every refusal; it is not a drop-in Wal structure replacement.
hosted_bridge_responsibilities: source/image qualification and immutable executable mapping
